==================
Simple see statement
==================

see "Hello World"

---

(source_file
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
See with string concatenation
==================

see "Hello " + name + nl

---

(source_file
  (see_statement
    (binary_expression
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier))
      (identifier))))

==================
Give statement
==================

give nOption

---

(source_file
  (give_statement
    (identifier)))

==================
Question mark shorthand for see
==================

? "Hello"

---

(source_file
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
Multiline string literal
==================

See "
        Hello
        Welcome to the Ring
    "

---

(source_file
  (see_statement
    (string)))

==================
Dynamically typed variables
==================

x = "Hello"
see x + nl
x = 5
see x + nl
x = 1.2
see x + nl

---

(source_file
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (string)))
  (see_statement
    (binary_expression
      (identifier)
      (identifier)))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (number)))
  (see_statement
    (binary_expression
      (identifier)
      (identifier)))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (number)))
  (see_statement
    (binary_expression
      (identifier)
      (identifier))))

==================
Weakly typed conversion
==================

x = 10
y = "20"
sum = x + y

---

(source_file
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (number)))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (string)))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))

==================

==================

if novalue() = NULL
    See "no value" + nl
ok

(source_file
